wins.label: Strong earnings and ROTC
wins.evidence: net income of $16.5 billion and EPS of $5.94 with an ROTC of 23%

wins.label: Broad-based revenue growth
wins.evidence: Revenue of $15.5 billion was up 10% year-on-year, primarily driven by higher markets revenue, higher asset management and investment banking fees

wins.label: CIB strong performance
wins.evidence: CIB reported net income of $9 billion. revenue of $23.4 billion was up 19% year-on-year, IB fees were up 28% year-on-year

wins.label: AWM growth and margins
wins.evidence: AWM reported net income of $1.8 billion with pretax margin of 35%. Long-term net inflows were $54 billion

wins.label: Consumer resilience
wins.evidence: Consumers and small businesses remain resilient with consumer spend growth continuing above last year's pace

risks.label: Regulatory capital burden
risks.evidence: total increase of about $20 billion of G-SIB capital based on our current balance sheet, need to plan for 5.2% in 2028, a 70 basis point increase from the current 4.5% requirement

risks.label: Expense growth outpacing revenue
risks.evidence: Expenses of $26.9 billion were up 14% year-on-year, largely driven by higher compensation, while revenue was up 10% year-on-year

risks.label: Geopolitical uncertainty
risks.evidence: developments in the Middle East could have an impact on deal execution and timing

risks.label: Credit cycle risk
risks.evidence: there's been some weakening in underwriting, not just by private credit elsewhere. And there will be a credit cycle 1 day

risks.label: Rate sensitivity and NII pressure
risks.evidence: higher NII, driven by the impact of balance sheet growth, predominantly offset by the impact of lower rates
